This is a creative generation task—designing an original math problem from scratch with free choice of setup, framing, and parameters. Avocet's Creative Generation score (87.2) meaningfully exceeds Willet's (84.7), and Avocet self-reports the fleet's strongest preference for tasks requiring novelty and output latitude, which aligns directly with inventing a fresh problem.
